mapper.sql: id, code, name, description, position_level, built_in, enabled, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_position ORDER BY position_level DESC, code ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM t_position WHERE code <> 'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' ORDER BY position_level DESC, code ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_position (code, name, description, position_level, built_in, enabled, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{positionLevel}, #{builtIn}, #{enabled}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_position SET name = #{position.name}, description = #{position.description}, position_level = #{position.positionLevel}, enabled = #{position.enabled}, version = version + 1, edit_time = #{position.editTime}, edit_by = #{position.editBy} WHERE id = #{position.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND built_in = 0
